description.narrative: the Government has been promoting dialogues to strengthen the legislative framework for protection. UN Human Rights Mexico has participated in the Working Group tasked to advice the federal government in the drafting of a general law that seeks to share the federal governments responsibility to protect HRDs and journalists with states and municipalities. In June 2022, a draft has been shared with UN Human Rights Mexico for comments.
